record.title_md: [Informal Belief on Non-Optimality of p-Goodness Bound](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.09205)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Belief on Non-Optimality of p-Goodness Bound
dossier_meta.statement_text: The bound $n \geq 2^{k^{10p}}$ in Theorem 1.1 is not best possible.
dossier_meta.context_text: Immediately after stating Theorem 1.1, the authors remark that they do not expect the bound $n \geq 2^{k^{10p}}$ to be best possible, and indicate that they discuss this further in the concluding remarks (Section 4).
